Chapter 1 I Have Three Phase Palaces
Great Xia Kingdom, Tianshu County.

In Nanfeng City in June, the sun is scorching like fire, scorching the earth.

Nanfeng Secondary School.

Spacious and bright training ground.

Many young and youthful boys and girls wearing exercise uniforms sat around cross-legged, looking at the center of the venue. There, there were two figures in a quick confrontation. When the wooden swords in their hands collided fiercely, there was a crisp sound, echoing In the training ground.

The two people in the arena are both about fifteen or sixteen years old. The boy on the right has a tall body, a handsome face, bright eyes under his brows, and a good figure and temperament. Not to mention other things, just this top-notch good skin attracts people's attention. When some young girls in the arena stared at them with bright eyes, they were full of amused glances, with a hint of shyness in them.

"Li Luo, come on!"

There are also bold girls cheering.

In front of the young man named Li Luo was a burly young man with a rather rough face and dark skin. Compared with Li Luo, he was really like a man and a black bear.

So when he heard the voices of those girls cheering for Li Luo, he grinned jealously, and immediately shouted: "Li Luo, I won't let the water go!"

When he stepped out, the floor trembled, and the wooden sword in his hand cut through the air, making a faint sound of breaking wind, and slashed towards Li Luo who was in front of him.

As the sword shadow slashed, Li Luo's eyes flashed, and his toes pointed, the figure flew out quickly, his steps were as nimble as a flying bird, and he directly avoided the heavy and sharp sword.

"It's the Wind Sparrow Step!" Someone in the field uttered a voice with some admiration. This Wind Sparrow Step is a low-level physiognomy. There are many people present, but few people are as proficient as Li Luo.

Li Luo's figure rushed in front of the burly young man like a flying bird, and suddenly drew the wooden sword in his hand. At that moment, there seemed to be a flash of light, stabbing at the burly young man in front of him extremely fast. Teenage chest.

"Little Spirit Light Sword!" Someone exclaimed again, Li Luo's sword, like an antelope's horns, flashed with inspiration, fast and ruthless, which made them have to sigh, this No. 1 understanding of Nanfeng Academy is really real Well-deserved reputation.

The sword shadow rushed towards him, and the complexion of the burly young man also changed, but his strength was not ordinary. He forcibly stabilized his figure at a critical moment, stomped his feet, and retreated a few steps.

At the same time, there was a faint layer of silver light on the surface of his body, and the palm holding the wooden sword seemed to have turned into a blurred silver bear's paw.

At the same time, there was a low bear roar, faintly emanating from the burly boy's body.

Seeing this scene, many students in the field immediately exclaimed: "That is Zhao Kuo's fifth-grade silver bear appearance, it seems that he is here for real!"

Amidst the many exclamations, Zhao Kuo took a step forward, and a gap was cracked in the floor. The epee in his hand was wrapped in fierce and brute force, causing a storm, and slashed fiercely at Li Luo in front of him.

Above the wooden sword, there was a silver light rising, and the sound of breaking wind, piercingly resounded.

"Violent cut!"

The burly boy shouted violently, and the red light slashed down, directly colliding with the stabbing sword shadow.

boom!
In the next moment, the two swords collided head-on.

During the violent collision, the wooden sword in Li Luo's hand almost collapsed at the touch of a touch, and a force like a violent bear surged in, and the whole wooden sword was shattered by the forceful shock.

A strong force came, shaking Li Luo's figure back more than ten steps.

Li Luo stabilized his steps, looked down at the broken wooden sword in his hand, smiled helplessly, and said, "Okay, Zhao Kuo, you won."

"Ugh."

As soon as this remark came out, some girls in the venue immediately made regretful voices, while many teenagers sniggered. After all, as young people with full blood, they certainly felt that Li Luo was so popular among girls. jealous.

"It's a pity. Li Luo's offensive is obviously stronger. He is also much better than Zhao Kuo in the application of physiognomy. If it wasn't for his incompetence, he must have won this match." Someone commented.

"That's right, Zhao Kuo possesses a fifth-grade silver bear appearance, and his strength is astonishing, and his strength is probably at the level of five seals. He really deserves to be the strongest person in our Second Academy."

"Li Luo's comprehension and talent in practicing physiognomy are indeed powerful, but he was born with a void, which is simply flawed. Without enough powerful physiognomy to support it, no matter how proficient in physiognomy, it will not be of much use."

"Haha, don't sympathize with others. Who is Li Luo, the young master of "Luolan Mansion", one of the four great mansions in my Great Xia Kingdom, and his parents are the youngest marquises in my Great Xia Kingdom. In just ten years, the established Luolan Mansion has become one of the four great mansions of the Great Xia Kingdom, and they are not only famous in the Great Xia Kingdom, but even outside of the Great Xia Kingdom."

"Hey, what time is it? You still say that these old Huangli, since Li Luo's parents disappeared in the "Warriors' Battlefield" three years ago, Luolan Mansion has not been as good as before, and from the news I heard, this Luo Lan Mansion , the differences are huge now, and they might split up in the future, I'm afraid he won't be able to be the young Palace Master."

"Oh? What's the matter? The current leader of the Luolan Mansion should be Senior Sister Jiang Qing'e, right?"

As soon as this name came out, the eyes of all the teenagers present became much hotter, because that name was a legend in their Nanfeng High School.

However, when they changed their minds and thought about the relationship between this legendary senior sister and Li Luo, they couldn't help but feel a little weird looking at the latter.

While many teenagers and girls in the arena were whispering, Zhao Kuo in the arena also walked towards Li Luo. He patted the latter's shoulder and grinned, "Are you all right? Don't blame me for my incompetence."

Li Luo smiled, this Zhao Kuo is straightforward, and he has a good relationship with him on weekdays, and he didn't violate any rules in this matter.

After all, his innate emptiness is his biggest flaw, so Zhao Kuo cannot be blamed.

On the sidelines, a middle-aged man turned his eyes away from the two people in the field. His name was Xu Shanyue, and he was the teacher of the Second Academy.

His eyes were also full of pity.

Li Luo's comprehension is excellent, and any physiognomy can be practiced faster than ordinary people in his hands. In this regard, he obviously inherited the advantages of his two arrogant parents, and even surpassed others.

But what is regrettable is that Li Luo was born with an empty appearance, but he had some troubles in the cultivation of Xiangli.

The cultivation of the human race relies on its own mutuality, which is the fundamental thing of cultivation.

Absorb the energy of heaven and earth with phase property, and what is finally formed is called phase force.

There are countless types of human body phases, but they are generally divided into two categories, elemental phases and myriad animal phases.

Elemental phases are many elements in the world, such as water, fire, wind, thunder, etc., and this so-called beast phase is the beginning of the human race according to legend. There is a supreme powerhouse who wants to strengthen the power of the human race, so he takes the spirit of the beasts and integrates into the human race. Bloodline, which gave birth to the so-called Ten Thousand Beasts.

Regardless of whether it is an elemental aspect or a myriad beast aspect, there are grades, and it is discussed in terms of grades one to nine, which are easy to understand.

When a human child grows up in his teens, there will be an opening in his body, and this opening is called Xianggong.

And when the phase palace appears, it will naturally derive its own phase nature.

Like this Zhao Kuo, in his Aspect Palace, a five-rank silver bear aspect has been awakened, which belongs to a kind of ten thousand beast aspect.

The characteristic of this phase is that it has great power, and combined with its own strength, the destructive power can be described as quite astonishing.

But Li Luo's problem also appeared here, because since the phase palace in his body was opened, no phase properties have been revealed in it, and it is empty inside, so it is called an extremely rare empty phase.

And without phase property as the fundamental thing to absorb and refine the energy between heaven and earth, it would be difficult for Li Luo to cultivate a strong phase force. This is the most fundamental reason why he lost to Zhao Kuo.

Because of his phase palace, there is no phase.

Regarding the question of Li Luo's empty appearance, many tests have been carried out in the school. After all, because his two parents are too outstanding, the high-level officials of the school had high hopes for Li Luo's admission, and felt that his future would be inevitable. To be able to enter the top institution of higher learning in the Great Xia Kingdom, the Saint Xuanxing Academy.

But in the first year of school, Li Luo lived up to expectations. He showed an amazing talent in the practice of physiognomy, and was directly admitted to the first courtyard of Nanfeng Academy, where the whole world gathered. The most talented young man in Shu County.

But as time went by, when the student's age reached the stage where the Xianggong appeared, he revealed the most embarrassing situation.

That is, other people have their own phase nature, but although his phase palace was born, it is empty inside.

Without his own compatibility, although Li Luo said that he was always one step ahead in the practice of physiognomy, his own strength improved quite slowly. After a year, it was even lower than the average level of the first academy.

And the practice of physiognomy is to be able to exert the phase force stronger, but if the phase force is weak, no matter how advanced the physiognomy is, its power is limited.

After repeated tests, the senior officials of the school came to a conclusion that this should be the reason for Li Luo's constitution.

This kind of physique lacks compatibility in the body, so it is difficult to absorb and refine the energy of heaven and earth, and it will be extremely difficult to practice in the future.

As soon as the result came out, the physiognomist in the first courtyard directly applied to the senior management of the school, demoting Li Luo from the first courtyard to the current second courtyard.

This is actually normal. After all, the first courtyard is the pride of Nanfeng Academy. The physiognomist naturally didn't want to let Li Luo be hindered. Of course, the most important thing is that Li Luo's parents had been missing for a long time at that time, and Losing these two pillars, the Luo Lan Mansion, which is considered the weakest among the four major mansions, has been in Daxia's country for these years, and the situation has become a bit embarrassing.

So Li Luo finally came to the Second Courtyard.

Xu Shanyue secretly sighed in his heart, when Li Luo first came to the Second Hospital, Zhao Kuo was actually not his opponent, but now only half a year later, Li Luo has already begun to be suppressed by Zhao Kuo.

At this rate, I am afraid that Li Luo's ranking in the Second Academy will gradually decline in the next six months.

If Li Luo only got this result in the end, the Saint Xuanxing higher education institution that everyone yearns for in the Great Xia Kingdom should be missed.

Xu Shanyue looked at Li Luo's long figure and handsome and calm face, and felt more and more regretful. In fact, this young man has worked very hard, but because his parents are too good and outstanding, it also caused others to hate him. The expectations are raised very high, and now, those excellent parents have become a kind of pressure on him.

After all, others will only talk about the tiger father and dog son, but will not go to understand deeper things.

Facing many regretful eyes, Li Luo slapped off all the sawdust on his body, and immediately sat down cross-legged at the side. Of course, he knew what everyone was thinking at this time.

It's empty.
This simply shows that the future is bleak.

It's just that Li Luo pursed his lips slightly, and involuntarily touched the position of his lower abdomen with his palm. In fact, except himself, no one knew that his specialness was not just the so-called empty appearance.

Practitioners in this world will only have one Xianggong in their bodies at the beginning, and if they step into the Marquis Realm in the future, they will have a second Xianggong, and when they enter the King Realm, they will have a third Xianggong. Realm, the entire Great Xia Kingdom is one of the few, and as for King Realm, even in this tyrannical Great Xia country, it is rarely heard of.

Of course, this is not absolute. It is rumored that people with extraordinary talents have a very low probability of giving birth to a second phase palace before reaching the feudal state when they advance to the phase power level. However, this probability, Also extremely rare.

And Li Luo's other special feature is here. Although he is only in the initial stage of the ten seals, there is not one Xianggong in his body, but three unheard of!
That's right, this was originally a level that only the peak powerhouses who stepped into the king realm could reach, but it happened to appear in Li Luo's body.

But what makes people feel even more ups and downs is that these three phase palaces are all empty!
Therefore, one emptiness has no future, so may I ask, three emptinesses, are they promising or not?
Li Luo sighed, looking a little melancholy.

When Li Luo was in a complicated state of mind, Zhao Kuo also sat down beside him, and asked in a low voice, "Have you still not solved the problem of emptiness?"

Li Luo just shook his head upon hearing this.

When Zhao Kuo saw this, he also sighed helplessly. He knew that he seemed to be asking nonsense. Affinity is innate.

Li Luo's question is obviously a huge problem.

While the two were talking, Xu Shanyue walked into the arena, gave Li Luo a few words of encouragement, and finally said to many students: "Everyone, starting next month, it will be the most important stage of the big exam. Whether you can enter an institution of higher learning depends on this assessment, so let's work hard on our own."

Many students heard the words, all of them looked solemn. They have studied hard for several years, and what they are doing is the big exam next month. If they can use this to enter a higher education institution, their future achievements will also be greatly improved. .

After Xu Shanyue finished speaking, he announced the dismissal of get out of class.

Li Luo and Zhao Kuo also flowed out of the training ground side by side along with the flow of people.

"I want to practice physiognomy again. I was hit by you today, you pervert. If your physiognomy was stronger, I should be hanged and beaten by you." Zhao Kuo left the training ground and sighed melancholy. He breathed a sigh of relief, and then waved goodbye to Li Luo.

Li Luo looked at his back and smiled. He actually understood that it was Zhao Kuo who was afraid that the previous victory or defeat would affect his mood, so he walked away first.

It's just that after such a long time, he has long been used to it.

Li Luo withdrew his gaze, then walked along the forest path towards the outside of the academy.

You can meet many students along the way, but no matter men or women, they will all cast their eyes on him. After all, even apart from this handsome appearance, Li Luo can be regarded as a person with an alternative legendary reputation in this school.

As for those gazes, Li Luo was rather indifferent. He walked along the path until he stopped at the entrance of the school.

In front of it, there was a large crowd of people gathering and making noise.

The place surrounded by those students is a bluestone wall, which is the honor wall of Nanfeng Academy, recording all the talented people who have walked out of Nanfeng Academy.

The students of Nanfeng Academy have seen this wall of honor countless times. Logically speaking, they should be a little bored, but this place is still the most lively every day.

Li Luo pursed his lips. Of course he knew the reason, because most of the people here came for her.

Li Luo's eyes turned to a position above the wall of honor, where there was a crystal stone, from which rays of light emanated, and finally intertwined into a slender, tall and lifelike figure.

It was a girl, she was wearing the school uniform of Nanfeng Academy, a simple white Uesugi, and a blue short cloak over Uesugi, which fluttered in the wind, her lower body was a black skirt, and under the skirt was a pair of straight and slender Her long legs are dazzlingly white.

She has exquisite facial features, a straight nose, thick and slender eyelashes, and snowy skin, but although each of these points is admirable, the most memorable thing is the girl's pupils.

Those were a pair of golden pupils, exuding an indescribable purity, if one looked directly at them for a long time, it would even bring a sense of oppression.

Her expression was a little cold, she stared ahead, with one hand crossing her slender waist, and the other hand was holding an epee, so in an instant, that sassy, ​​sharp and powerful feeling was Come on.

This is a girl who makes people's hearts flutter regardless of her appearance or temperament.

On the wall behind its light and shadow, the girl's name is engraved.

Jiang Qing'e, the bright pearl who came out of Nanfeng Academy, possessed a ninth-grade luminous appearance, and her talent attracted countless people in the Great Xia Kingdom to marvel.

After two years of schooling, before the entrance examination, he was directly recruited by the Saint Xuanxing Academy in the Great Xia Kingdom, and became the No.1 in Tianshu County with this honor in a hundred years.

She has become the legend of Nanfeng Academy, and countless later students look up to her here, and now she is very famous in the entire Great Xia.

Li Luo stared blankly at Jiang Qing'e's light and shadow, and then he noticed that some eyes were cast on him. Those students, no matter male or female, looked at him with some unwillingness, envy and strangeness. .

Li Luo was still indifferent to their gazes, he understood the source of these gazes.

Because of Jiang Qing'e.

This Nanfeng Academy, regardless of male or female students, is regarded as a goddess-like person. Not only is he a disciple accepted by his parents since he was a child, but he also has a marriage contract with him.

To put it bluntly, Jiang Qing'e is his fiancee.

(The new book has opened, thank you for your support, no matter new readers or old readers, I hope the king of all phases can accompany you again in the future.

Haha, this time when writing a new book, Li Luo feels like an old father. Maybe it's because I'm also a father?
Well, I hope that everyone will like the new book. This is my greatest honor. )
(End of this chapter)
